title: Italian Game: the ideas
line: The bishop aims at f7 and White prepares d4.

steps.text: The bishop on c4 aims at f7, the square only the king guards.
Play Black now. Bring a bishop out to face White's, on c5.
steps.hint: The bishop on f8 can reach c5.
steps.after: Each bishop now aims at the other side's king.

steps.text: White's c3 prepares a pawn move to the center. Tap the square that pawn goes to.

wrong.d3: d3 is a quieter square. c3 guards the one in front of it.

steps.after: With d4, White takes the center.

summary: In the Italian Game the bishop aims at f7 and White prepares d4.
